# CIDEX 2024 — 重庆阿泰可科技股份有限公司 (Chongqing ATEC Technology Co., Ltd.) — booth 1041

## Ringkasan

重庆阿泰可科技股份有限公司，简称 ATEC，是一家专业致力于可靠性试验技术研 究和气候环境模拟设备的创新型高科技企业，是国内专业从事气候环境试验设备的首家 上市公司。 ATEC 不仅可生产气候环境试验设备全系列标准产品，更是针对步入式试验舱及各种 ODM 定制产品，为各类气候环境模拟试验工程提供从设计到制造的全套解决方案。

- Produk dipamerkan: The CH series high and low temperature humidity and heat test chamber is widely used in industries such as aviation, aerospace, electronics, ships, instruments and meters to conduct accelerated humidity and heat tests on electrical and electronic products, materials, components, equipment, etc., as well as alternating humidity and heat tests and constant humidity and heat tests. It can also be used for routine high and low temperature tests and low-temperature storage, in order to evaluate the behavioral performance of the test object under given environmental conditions.
